0.original: The maidservant P'ebaloh comes to you for assistance, for her own fighting days are long past.

1.original: A mysterious monstrosity has been spotted on the beach. Proceed to the spot and slay three of the pugils that seem to flock to it.

2.original: A ripening carcass has been drawing the pugils to the area. Haul away the monster banquet, and all shall be well.

3.original: You have hauled the carcass away. Report to P'ebaloh, and try to stay downwind of her.

4.original: You speak to P'ebaloh and discover that groundskeepers have only recently tidied the beach. Dangerous visitors clearly grow more commonplace.

48.original: Good <hex:020839E3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF086576656E696E67FF086D6F726E696E6703FF17020813E3E90C12FF04646179FF086576656E696E670303>, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>, a word if I may. A visiting danseuse spotted strange fish on the beach and came screaming back to the house. She is a level-headed young person, so I fear 'tis no vapors.

49.original: The beach is no place for any frolics until the truth is ascertained. I turn to you once again. May we trouble you to check the beach?

52.original: Pugils, on the beaches of Costa del Sol! We live in strange times. The carcass must have drifted ashore, for it seems to have been dead longer than a day or two, and that is when the beach was last tidied by the keepers.

53.original: Thank you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6127616DFF0473697203>. You need not stay downwind─I have smelled that smell before. We must step up the groundskeeping, I fear. Master Gegeruju is likely to have one of his ideas otherwise.
